---
title: "Proverbs"
---

# Proverbs

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Proverbs presents practical wisdom for godly living. The book teaches that the fear of the Lord is the foundation of true wisdom and righteous living.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 1:7</div>

<div class="identifier">The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge</div>

### Why This Verse

Foundation of Proverbs

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces the purpose of Proverbs and warns against sinful influences. The key verse establishes reverence for God as the foundation of true knowledge.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 2:6</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD gives wisdom</div>

### Why This Verse

Source of wisdom

### Chapter Insight

This chapter encourages the pursuit of wisdom. The key verse emphasizes that wisdom is a gift from the Lord.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 3:5</div>

<div class="identifier">Trust in the LORD with all thine heart</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted verses in the Bible

### Chapter Insight

This chapter teaches trust, obedience, and dependence upon God. The key verse calls believers to trust God rather than their own understanding.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 4:23</div>

<div class="identifier">Keep thy heart with all diligence</div>

### Why This Verse

Core wisdom principle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter urges wholehearted pursuit of wisdom. The key verse emphasizes guarding the heart because it shapes one's life.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 5:18</div>

<div class="identifier">Rejoice with the wife of thy youth</div>

### Why This Verse

Marriage fidelity

### Chapter Insight

This chapter warns against sexual immorality. The key verse highlights faithfulness within marriage.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 6:6</div>

<div class="identifier">Go to the ant, thou sluggard</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous diligence proverb

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses laziness, dishonesty, and adultery. The key verse warns against behaviors that God hates.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 7:2</div>

<div class="identifier">Keep my commandments and live</div>

### Why This Verse

Wisdom and protection

### Chapter Insight

This chapter vividly warns against temptation and adultery. The key verse demonstrates the destructive consequences of yielding to temptation.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 8:35</div>

<div class="identifier">He that finds me finds life</div>

### Why This Verse

Wisdom personified

### Chapter Insight

This chapter presents wisdom as calling out to humanity. The key verse highlights wisdom's value and its role in creation.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 9:10</div>

<div class="identifier">Fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom</div>

### Why This Verse

Repeated foundational theme

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts the invitations of wisdom and folly. The key verse again establishes the fear of the Lord as the beginning of wisdom.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 10:12</div>

<div class="identifier">Love covers all sins</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently quoted proverb

### Chapter Insight

This chapter begins Solomon's collection of practical proverbs. The key verse contrasts righteousness and wickedness in daily life.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 11:25</div>

<div class="identifier">The liberal soul shall be made fat</div>

### Why This Verse

Generosity principle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter emphasizes integrity, generosity, and humility. The key verse highlights the value of honest dealings.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 12:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Whoever loves instruction loves knowledge</div>

### Why This Verse

Teachable spirit

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts wisdom and foolishness. The key verse teaches that discipline is essential for growth.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 13:20</div>

<div class="identifier">He that walks with wise men shall be wise</div>

### Why This Verse

Influence principle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter focuses on diligence, speech, and wise relationships. The key verse emphasizes the influence of companions.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 14:12</div>

<div class="identifier">There is a way that seems right unto a man</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Proverbs' best-known warnings

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts wise and foolish living. The key verse teaches that reverence for God provides confidence and security.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 15:1</div>

<div class="identifier">A soft answer turns away wrath</div>

### Why This Verse

Extremely popular proverb

### Chapter Insight

This chapter highlights the power of words and humility. The key verse demonstrates how gentle speech can defuse conflict.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 16:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Commit thy works unto the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Guidance and planning

### Chapter Insight

This chapter emphasizes God's sovereignty over human plans. The key verse teaches believers to entrust their plans to God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 17:17</div>

<div class="identifier">A friend loves at all times</div>

### Why This Verse

Friendship

### Chapter Insight

This chapter focuses on relationships and character. The key verse celebrates faithful friendship during adversity.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 18:21</div>

<div class="identifier">Death and life are in the power of the tongue</div>

### Why This Verse

Influence of speech

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses wisdom in speech and relationships. The key verse highlights the power of words to influence life and death.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 19:17</div>

<div class="identifier">He that has pity on the poor lends to the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Compassion principle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter stresses wisdom, compassion, and integrity. The key verse emphasizes God's direction over human plans.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 20:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Wine is a mocker</div>

### Why This Verse

Well-known warning

### Chapter Insight

This chapter discusses honesty, diligence, and justice. The key verse highlights the value of wise counsel.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 21:3</div>

<div class="identifier">To do justice and judgment</div>

### Why This Verse

Righteous living

### Chapter Insight

This chapter emphasizes God's control over human affairs. The key verse demonstrates God's sovereignty even over kings.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 22:6</div>

<div class="identifier">Train up a child in the way he should go</div>

### Why This Verse

Most cited parenting proverb

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains practical wisdom for family and community life. The key verse emphasizes training children in godly ways.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 23

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 23:7</div>

<div class="identifier">As he thinks in his heart, so is he</div>

### Why This Verse

Popular wisdom verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter warns against excess, greed, and foolishness. The key verse urges guarding the heart's desires and affections.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 24

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 24:16</div>

<div class="identifier">A just man falls seven times and rises again</div>

### Why This Verse

Perseverance

### Chapter Insight

This chapter praises wisdom and perseverance. The key verse encourages resilience after failure.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 25

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 25:21</div>

<div class="identifier">If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread</div>

### Why This Verse

Quoted in Romans 12

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains additional proverbs of Solomon. The key verse teaches self-control and humility.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 26

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 26:11</div>

<div class="identifier">As a dog returns to his vomit</div>

### Why This Verse

Quoted in 2 Peter

### Chapter Insight

This chapter warns against foolishness and laziness. The key verse highlights the danger of meddling in others' disputes.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 27

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 27:17</div>

<div class="identifier">Iron sharpens iron</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted Proverbs

### Chapter Insight

This chapter emphasizes friendship, humility, and diligence. The key verse highlights the refining influence of godly relationships.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 28

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 28:1</div>

<div class="identifier">The righteous are bold as a lion</div>

### Why This Verse

Courage

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts the righteous and the wicked. The key verse emphasizes confession and forsaking sin.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 29

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 29:18</div>

<div class="identifier">Where there is no vision, the people perish</div>

### Why This Verse

Widely quoted leadership verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter focuses on leadership and discipline. The key verse stresses the necessity of God's revelation for moral direction.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 30

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 30:5</div>

<div class="identifier">Every word of God is pure</div>

### Why This Verse

Trustworthiness of Scripture

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the sayings of Agur. The key verse expresses humility before God's wisdom and truth.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 31

<div class="key-verse">Proverbs 31:30</div>

<div class="identifier">Charm is deceitful and beauty is vain</div>

### Why This Verse

Virtuous woman passage

### Chapter Insight

This chapter concludes with wisdom from King Lemuel and the virtuous woman. The key verse teaches that reverence for God is the highest measure of character.
:::
